This video is Montana's entry in 50x50: Science Across America — 50 creators meeting 50 scientists, one pair in each state.

All 50 states: https://www.youtube.com/@50x50Science

Dr. Lila Fishman's lab: https://www.fishmanlab.org

More 50x50 videos:
GEO GIRL (South Carolina) - South Carolina's Ancient Ocean Holds Clues About the Future of the Coast: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sV_yJ1X5kJY
John (Indiana) - Correcting a Mistake in Everything Is Tuberculosis: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OmQ6GXM5gro

50x50: Science Across America is a national series uncovering exceptional science in all 50 states. It is a production of the Independent Media Initiative in collaboration with HHMI Tangled Bank Studios, Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, and the Winn Family Foundation. See all the states at 5050science.com.

Filmed by Andrew Weed (Plethora Films)
Edited by Milo Erbach and Hank Green
